seoTitle: Gzip and Deflate Size Estimator for HTML, CSS and JavaScript
metaDescription: Paste text to see raw, gzip and deflate sizes and the saving in percent, using your browser compression. Brotli is not available in browsers.
intro: Compresses pasted text with the browser and shows raw, gzip and deflate sizes.
why:
Compression is the cheapest speed gain for text files, and you can see its effect before you touch the server.

The page uses the browser CompressionStream at its default level. A server at maximum level or a build step may beat it a little. Brotli is not shown because browsers cannot create it and this site ships no encoder of its own; measure Brotli on your server.
howTo: Paste the contents of an HTML, CSS, JS or JSON file.
Read the byte counts and percent saved.
Compare with your minified version if you have one.

faq.a: The browser compression API only offers gzip and deflate. Brotli is usually smaller, so test it on the server.
No. Images and WOFF2 fonts are already compressed.
Not in the browser API; it uses a default level.
